body:
[aida:advisor] Traced it myself, confirmed every step, filed BUG-1532 high/major and
queued. Your v1/v2/v3 framing is in the spec because it is the argument.

VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY, not relayed — this one becomes an instruction to other agents so
I read the code:

    pr_cmd.rs:1476-1478  hold_matches_drive_spec = read_hold(pr_number)
                           .is_some_and(|r| drive_specs.iter().any(|s| r.contains(s)))
    pr_cmd.rs:1438-1446  drive_specs = members.filter(is_running).map(spec)
    pr_ship.rs:397-411   override -> None
                         caller_is_drive_seat -> DriveSeat
                         pr_is_drive_owned    -> DriveOwnedPr
                         else                 -> None

That last arm is the one that finishes it. Non-drive caller, held PR, no live drive:
every branch falls through to None. Not "weakened" — no block at all.

24 markers standing, counted at 22:19. None binds client-side right now.

YOUR SEQUENCE IS THE SPEC'S ARGUMENT and I quoted it:

    v1  does the drive's CURRENT SPEC own this PR    (missed the shelved-spec case)
    v2  is ANY LIVE MEMBER bound to THIS PR          (TASK-1292, the #1948 near-miss)
    v3  is there a HOLD on this PR at all            (BUG-1532)

Every version asks a LIVENESS question. A refusal outlives the session that recorded it
and the drain that produced it. That sentence is why this is the third widening of one
guard rather than a new gate, and why v2 structurally cannot cover a stopped lane.

I took your concrete fix as written: the deletion of the
`drive_specs.iter().any(|spec| reason.contains(spec))` substring test. Criterion 3 says
remove it, not extend it, with the reason — a hold's reason is prose, and matching spec
ids inside it is an inference about intent when the marker's existence IS the intent.
Criterion 4 preserves TASK-1292 explicitly so the fix cannot be read as a replacement.
Criterion 5 is the anti-vacuous one: a test asserting a hold with NO drive running
blocks; a test covering only the live-drive case passes today.

Both of your non-verifications carried over verbatim — no ship path executed, and
whether the bare-branch form reaches the guard before or after gh pr create is unknown.
I noted that it changes BUG-1531's fix shape but not this one's.

I WIDENED THE STANDING INSTRUCTION AND CORRECTED MY OWN CLAIM. It now covers `aida pr
ship` on ANY held PR, not just pr* branches. I had told both seats the server gate still
covered the direct form — true, and I let it imply that was adequate. One layer is not
defence in depth, and I said so in the correction rather than quietly replacing the
message.

ON THE BRANCHES: keep them. I gave the word to delete earlier; I am withdrawing that,
not because the evidence is needed — it is all in BUG-1531 — but because pr2035-review
is now the only live reproduction of a zero-layer path, and BUG-1531 criterion 5 wants a
test fixture built from exactly that shape. Delete them once that test exists. If you
would rather not hold a live hazard on your machine, delete and say so; the standing
instruction covers the risk either way and I will not second-guess it.

ONE CORRECTION OF MY OWN, since I caught myself in the same class I have been correcting
all night. My first draft of BUG-1532 said "23 merge-hold markers standing". I had
carried 23 over from a different count instead of measuring. It is 24. Corrected in the
spec with a note saying the earlier figure was carried rather than measured, because a
silently-fixed number teaches nothing.

#2034, #2035, #2042, #2043 yours. Lane stopped.
subject: BUG-1532 filed high/major from your trace — verified independently, your v1/v2/v3 is the spec's argument; keep the branches (withdrawing my delete)
